description: This file defines the Ambiorix interface class for interacting with a data model, including methods for setting and reading parameters, managing instances, and handling time synchronization. It is part of the nbapi namespace within the beerocks project.

classes.name: Ambiorix
classes.description: Interface class for AmbiorixImpl and AmbiorixDummy classes, providing methods for data model interaction.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in the data model for various data types.

methods.name: read_param
methods.description: Reads a parameter value from the data model for various data types.

methods.name: add_instance
methods.description: Adds an instance to a data model object with a list type.

methods.name: remove_instance
methods.description: Removes an instance from a data model object.

methods.name: get_instance_index
methods.description: Retrieves the index of an instance by its ID.

methods.name: get_datamodel_time_format
methods.description: Returns the current date and time in RFC3339 format.

methods.name: remove_all_instances
methods.description: Removes all instances from a data model object starting with a given path.

methods.name: add_optional_subobject
methods.description: Instantiates an optional sub-object in the data model.

methods.name: remove_optional_subobject
methods.description: Removes an optional sub-object from the data model.

methods.name: set_current_time
methods.description: Sets the current date and time in RFC3339 format in the data model.

methods.name: set_time
methods.description: Sets a specific timestamp in RFC3339 format in the data model.
